mixed/legal-clerc-200.caveat: SCALE MISMATCH, not a comparison class issue: CLERC's own retrieval collection is 1.84M documents / 23.7M passages; our mixed/legal-clerc-200 corpus is a 198-document candidate pool (200 roughly 260-word citation queries; every retained document is judged relevant to at least one query). nDCG@10 on a ~200-document pool is structurally far easier than on a 1.84M-document collection, so a score on our pool is NOT 'beating published BM25 (0.054)' — it reflects a much smaller candidate set. Cited to establish CLERC as a real, citable academic legal-retrieval benchmark grounding this corpus, not as a head-to-head score comparison.

Same scale-mismatch caveat as the BM25 row above — full 1.84M-doc/23.7M-passage collection vs. our 198-document pool. Listed as the strongest zero-shot dense baseline CLERC reports (ahead of E5 v2 0.0367, BGE En v1.5 0.0343, DPR 0.0224).
